entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: It just hit me again... coming[n]here in normal clothes is[n]pretty dangerous, huh...?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Well, if someone finds out...[n]I'll just say I'm visiting[n]the home of a troublemaker.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: It sounds awful to say, but...[n]I'm glad you came here with[n]those special circumstances.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: It's actually made it a lot [n]easier to come up with[n]reasons to see you.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: That old saying "loving is losing" is so true.
I wanna be with you forever.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Wow, that hit me right in my heart...[n]Geez... That's not fair.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: *giggle* See, was it so hard[n]to be honest for once?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I'm glad we can spend time[n]together like this too...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I... feel the same way...[n]That's why you gotta grow up fast.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: At least, enough that we don't[n]have to hide our relationship.[n]Don't worry, I'll wait for you...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: It's just... I really do love you.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I don't regret anything[n]anymore... thanks to you.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Let's stay together a little longer today...[n]Please?
